constraints.finding: Geth v1.17.10 and Prysm v7.3.1 cancel the previously scheduled Hoodi Amsterdam/Gloas activation. The old pair cannot establish current Hoodi compatibility.
constraints.required_evidence: Regenerate the pinned Hoodi fork/config fixture and verify the execution/consensus pair, identity, hooks, and restart behavior.

constraints.finding: The current source pair is selected for both profiles; Hoodi-specific release notes do not establish mainnet or Sepolia runtime compatibility.
constraints.required_evidence: Separate identity, genesis/fork config, execution/consensus, and capture proofs for each profile.

constraints.finding: Jenner is scheduled for mainnet at 1796697000 (2026-12-08 02:30 UTC) and testnet at 1793241000 (2026-10-29 02:30 UTC). The current testnet therefore needs the new paths now. Upgrading from v1.7.x also changes configuration and RPC behavior.
constraints.required_evidence: Source and fixture coverage for CAS20 stateful precompiles, payment-lane behavior, timestamp precision, native capture/fees/rollback, and both sides of applicable fork boundaries. Verify current mainnet and testnet separately.

constraints.finding: Uburu is already active at mainnet block 96787900 and Amoy block 51978200. Bor v2.10.3 no longer follows those chains. Bor v2.11.0 changes StateReceiver/state-sync execution and records; failed Heimdall fetches now fail the block.
constraints.required_evidence: Recheck Bor capture seams, system/state-sync ordering, failure/recovery and receipts at Uburu. Preserve sequential execution: BlockSTM, pipelined import, parallel stateless import, and preconfirmations remain disabled in the first profile.

constraints.finding: Karwar is active at Heimdall mainnet height 57006000 and Amoy height 50020000. Heimdall v0.13.2 is selected. Bor and Heimdall use different Cosmos/CometBFT replacement versions.
constraints.required_evidence: Build each upstream dependency graph separately; verify Bor/Heimdall compatibility and checkpoint/finality evidence. Use a dedicated Ethereum mainnet L1 pair for Polygon mainnet and a dedicated Sepolia L1 pair for Amoy.

constraints.finding: grpc-go v1.85.0 and nats.go v1.55.0 require Go 1.26.0. Geth/BSC source go directives remain 1.25.0; Bor/Heimdall require 1.26.10. Go 1.27.3 is the build candidate, not a proved native compiler upgrade.
constraints.required_evidence: Compile and test each native module and common service separately. Resolve generated-binding and dependency changes in their own modules; keep the NATS SDK in Gateway.

constraints.finding: grocksdb v1.11.0 was adapted for RocksDB 11.0.4; its compatibility with the selected RocksDB 11.13.2 is unproved.
constraints.required_evidence: Compile/link the C API and exercise sync WriteBatch, WAL recovery, bounded spool, restart, and corruption behavior before accepting this pair. A failure blocks promotion; it does not silently select older versions.

constraints.finding: NATS server and chart are separately pinned to 2.15.2. Helm 4.3.1 and Kubernetes 1.37.2 are metadata-verified candidates; their chart compatibility has not been tested. Optional chart sidecars are disabled.
constraints.required_evidence: Render/lint the chart, inspect actual image refs and permissions, verify JetStream limits/metadata/account checks, and run Compose/Kubernetes admission tests on the selected platform.

constraints.finding: OCI indexes and selected platform descriptors are pinned; platform layers were not executed. Direct Debian package metadata does not constitute a signed, resolved OS closure.
constraints.required_evidence: Verify signed Debian indexes and every downloaded package, resolve architecture-specific closures, record runtime libraries and generated image digests, and execute platform smoke tests. Linux/arm64 availability is not a support claim.

constraints.finding: The release prose ZIP checksums disagree with the release API and actual bytes. API checksums match downloaded archives. Both genesis JSON files omit jennerTime.
constraints.required_evidence: Use the verified archive hashes; validate chain/genesis identity and effective native fork configuration after init. The archive's existence or chainId alone does not establish fork correctness.

constraints.finding: Solidity v0.8.38 is selected for project-owned test contracts. Its default EVM target may differ from a profile's active fork.
constraints.required_evidence: Pin compiler bytes, explicit per-profile EVM target, source/ABI/bytecode hashes, inputs, and independent expected results. Verify the architecture of each compiler binary before running it.

candidate_policy.native_go_note: The newer compiler must pass each native build and capture gate. Upstream go directives and module graphs are preserved as inputs.
candidate_policy.c_cpp_toolchain: Debian 13 stable GCC/G++ 14 packages; no separate LLVM toolchain is introduced.
candidate_policy.optional_sidecars: Disabled in this candidate. Enabling any sidecar requires its own official update rule, immutable image pin, and checks before admission.
candidate_policy.solidity: Compile each fixture with an explicit EVM target supported by its profile/fork. The compiler default is not a profile rule.
